NewsArticle.Title: Ascension
NewsArticle.Content: Kiril, Undine Master of Magic, unearths an [ancient Aosdic scroll,](http://www.darkages.com/community/his) which Torgny, great dwarf below, had given him: The one of great insight after having proven his metal of Hybrasyl, Mythril, or Talgonite, after a great offering of [untranslated] to the gods, died. He entered the land of the dead, but instead of submitting to his fate, he searched among the rubble and found way that his spirit might cross the Abyss and arrive at a forbidden home of the gods. There his soul was bare. There he became fiery and great. There he became deep and great. He returned to world, more powerful now than before he had died. Abhul Kiril continues to attempt to translate it.
